_comment: CHURN CARD — 10-EPOCH SMOKE of the v4 arm (staged cadence: smoke first, >=1 h only
once it is clean).  Sole deltas over the leg config are the 300 s duration and its own
output/snapshot paths, so the treatment is identical.
WHAT A SMOKE CAN AND CANNOT SHOW.  It proves the wiring FIRES and is byte-safe: the OFF
arm must reproduce the base arm exactly, and each ON arm must show a NON-ZERO counter
(innov_suppressed for v3, the suppressed-kill count for v4).  It cannot show convergence
— 10 epochs from cold is still ignition, and no dd_sigma_cyc or med|frac_cyc| verdict may
be read from it.  That is what the 3 h legs are for.
